compressed_items.content: Preserve and reconstruct a research state as explicit purpose, assumptions, definitions, formal structures, hypotheses, predictions, methods, evidence/status and developmental directions rather than as a prose summary.
Source-labelled starting axioms define the framework's provisional constraints; source explicitly denies absolute-truth standing.

Adaptive-system ontology includes environment/state/representation/search/generator/reachability/frontier/capability/resources/constraints/adoption/execution/phase-boundary objects, with meaning preserved source-locally.

Source-internal dependency models connect generator change, adoption/execution, reachability and capability while preserving resource-scaling alternatives; these are theory graphs, not Program Map edges.

Core hypothesis family proposes that generator/improvement-process changes, representation changes and recursive feedback can precede and causally contribute to reachability/capability acceleration beyond resource scaling.

Registered predictions cover temporal ordering, generator change, reachability, representation, adoption/execution, resource controls, alignment and recursive acceleration; source explicitly says predictions are not evidence.
Experimental program uses controlled fixed-vs-adaptive generator comparisons, longitudinal trajectories, resource controls, ablations, intervention tests, falsification and meta-benchmarks.
Causal-identification proposals use counterfactuals, interventions, matched controls, mediation, ablation and delayed outcomes to distinguish generator effects from scaling/confounds.
Historical/civilizational cases are organized through common transformation-event schemas; examples are candidate applications and do not become validated history by inclusion.
Retrieval, external-anchor, self-improving-framework, implementation and multi-agent research architectures propose how research state could be stored, challenged, reconstructed and revised.
Alignment/control proposals span feedback, truth/reality coupling, monitoring, uncertainty, evaluation, rollback, sandboxing, proxy-goal checking and adaptive alignment generators.

AGI/recursive-intelligence designs propose representation/world-model, search, generator, evaluation, memory, interface, truth-coupling and alignment loops; these are specifications, not implementations.

Later engineering/OS proposals add bottleneck detection, improvement scheduling, multiple representations, evaluation/alignment kernels, intelligence APIs, sandboxed self-modification and distributed coordination.
Representation/invariant/geometry family proposes intelligence benefits from discovering coordinate systems that preserve useful structure, compress search and reshape reachable problem spaces.
Compression-generation family proposes structure-preserving compression can increase generative/search leverage rather than merely reduce storage.

compressed_items.content: Causal velocity/mass family models speed of influence, adoption/implementation bottlenecks, counterfactual dependence, persistence and accumulated future dependency.

Evolution/meta-learning family connects variation-selection-retention, learning-to-learn, recursive generator improvement, observer-reality coupling and movement through intelligence landscapes.
Civilization/human-AI theories treat institutions, science, interfaces, memory and AI as distributed transformation/generator infrastructure with coordination and alignment bottlenecks.
Recursive-intelligence economy extends production/value models with improvement capacity, cognitive capital/arbitrage, generator assets and evaluation/problem-selection bottlenecks.

Multiple later layers propose unified dynamical/intelligence equations over representation, compression, generators, reachability, alignment, causal mass, resources and feedback; no one formula is granted supersession authority.

Layers 52, 62 and 70 propose falsifiable validation programs spanning generator comparison, representation intervention, reachability, truth coupling, causal mass, alignment, interfaces, transfer and civilization-scale tests; none are execution records.
